description: Texts the composer trims or renders. single: opening pinned empty, composed as the empty text.
pair: the empty part still takes its place in the blank-line join, so the text starts with
'\n\n'; closing's leading and trailing newlines are trimmed. topics: a block's trailing
newlines and leading spaces are trimmed. sections: a point whose text holds its own '##'
heading is composed verbatim under its block heading. plan: the reply holding Markdown headings
and '{{' is rendered as a template before it composes ({{ 3 * 2 }} becomes 6, {{ "{{" }} a
literal '{{'); its trailing newline is trimmed. tone_line: the case's 'plain' branch. summary:
summary_then_opening: the zero-pass while (no part) and the empty opening (an empty part) compose
empty; topics_then_opening ends in the blank line before the empty opening.
